## ✅ Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the project's code style and conventions
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in complex areas
- [ ] I have updated documentation and README (if applicable)

### Testing
- [ ] I have added/updated tests for new features
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`npm run test` or equivalent)
- [ ] Test coverage maintained or improved (min 80%)
- [ ] I've tested on multiple browsers/devices (if UI change)

### Healthcare & Security (if applicable)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or credentials
- [ ] User inputs are validated and sanitized
- [ ] HIPAA compliance considered (if handling health data)
- [ ] Privacy implications reviewed
- [ ] Clinical accuracy verified (if health-related)

### Git & Process
- [ ] My branch is up-to-date with `main`
- [ ] Commits are clean and descriptive
- [ ] No merge conflicts
- [ ] PR title is clear and descriptive
